sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 5586 of 2022
Applicant :- Praveen Alias Chhotu S/O Shri Radhe Lal

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Nitin Kumar Srivastava,Ajeet Kumar Singh,Pradeep Kumar Tripathi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.

Heard Shri Pradeep Kumar Tripathi, learned counsel for the accused-applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
This bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Praveen Alias Chhotu for grant of bail, in Case Crime No. 97 of 2022, under Sections 354, 376-DA, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 5G/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station Mohanlalganj, District Lucknow, during trial.
Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the bail application submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case and he has not committed any offence as claimed by the prosecution.

It is further submitted that the F.I.R. of the incident is shown to have been lodged by the brother of one of the victim on 07.03.2022 against the instant applicant and other co-accused person who has been found juvenile, stating therein that on 06.03.2022 at about 4:00 pm. two victims had gone to ease themselves in an agricultural field where they were overpowered by the instant applicant and co-accused Naldeep and they also raped them.

1 victim of the instant case in her statement recorded under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., wherein it is stated that instant applicant had committed rape with the sister of the informant while the co-accused Naldeep committed rape with niece of the informant of the instant case.

sentences.text: Highlighting the above facts, it is vehemently submitted that during the course of investigation the prosecutrix of the instant case was medically examined on 07.03.2022 (within 24 hours of the alleged occurrence) and no injury of any kind and even no abnormality has been found in the pathological reports of the victim and, thus, the allegations of the prosecutrix as levelled in her statement recorded under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. have not found corroboration from the medical evidence, moreso in the background that the doctor has also not given any opinion pertaining to sexual assault.

It is vehemently submitted that as per the educational credentials the date of birth of the victim of the instant case has been found as 10.03.2003 whereby she comes about of 19 years at the date and time of the incident and, thus, at the relevant point of time she was major and in fact she was having an affair with the instant applicant and when she was seen by the informant, imputation of rape have been alleged against the applicant and other co-accused person.
It is further submitted that after investigation charge sheet has been filed and no offence pertaining to the POCSO Act has been found against the instant applicant.
Applicant is languishing in jail in this case since 07.03.2022 and he is not having any criminal history.
Charge sheet in this case has already been filed and there is no apprehension that after being released on bail he may flee from the course of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.
Learned A.G.A., however, opposes the prayer of bail of the applicant on the ground that the applicant has committed an heinous offence and, therefore, he is not entitled to be released on bail.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that notice of the instant proceedings was given to the opposite party no.2 (complainant/informant of the instant case) and as per the report of the offence he has been sufficiently served but nobody has appeared on behalf of the opposite party no.2.

In the first information report as well as in the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. allegation of rape has been levelled against the instant applicant and co-accused Naldeep.

The prosecutrix has been medically examined within 24 hours of the incident and no sign of struggle or injury or any pathological abnormality has been found in the medical examination report or pathological reports and it is in this background, it is vehemently submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that as the prosecutrix was major at the date and time of the incident, the whole story has been cooked up to screen the affair of the prosecutrix with the instant applicant.
Applicant is languishing in jail in this case since 07.03.2022 without any criminal antecedents.
Charge sheet in this case has also been filed and the presence of the applicant may be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.

Keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is thus allowed.

Let the accused/applicant- Praveen Alias Chhotu involved in above-mentioned case, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the Court concerned before the bonds are accepted.
Observations made herein-above by this court are only for the purpose of disposal of this bail application and shall not be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.
